name: branding-twelve-coffee-green-cream-blue-brand-board-with-packaging
title: Twelve Coffee Brand Board
whatItIs: A bento brand board for a coffee brand with a deep green tile and a wobbly cream wordmark, a mug-shaped logo on sky blue, a sign with a big 12, four colour swatches (Serenade, Palm Leaf, Sail, Fringy Flower), stacked iced coffee boxes against the sky, a person holding cream and green coffee bags with sideways wordmarks and an icon and type tile.
whatItMeans: A wavy chunky wordmark and a green, cream and sky palette feel playful yet premium, and the board shows the mark on sign, box and bag.
techniques: Wavy chunky wordmark with a mirrored letter
Green, cream and sky blue palette with named swatches
Icon set of coffee objects in cream on green
Photography of signage and packaging in a bento

vocabulary.definition: A logo shown on a shop sign.
A family of simple drawings in one style.
